On the abstract Bolza Richelot plane W, the natural branch-pair action fixes all three nonzero pair-difference classes. Exhausting integral anti-semilinear principal-polarization lifts on the retained Hermitian lattice gives six involutive lifts whose mod-2 action fixes all three W-lines; these six split into three pairs according to which W-line is fixed by the residual semilinear stabilizer. Hence the present source package does not choose an absolute W-line. A source-bound choice of one exact retained semilinear lift would be a genuinely pruning new datum.
